Part-Time Cleaner – London ON.description: Part-time cleaner for Instastay's short-term rental (Airbnb) homes in London, Ontario. The work is turnover cleaning between guest stays: beds and linens, bathrooms, kitchens, laundry, restocking supplies, and reporting any damage or maintenance issues (with photos) to the team.
